Text.5d7ab65d7560.en: Questions, news and help: the community on Discord
Text.5d7ab65d7560.zh-CN: 在 Discord 社区交流、查看消息和获取帮助

Text.04fb8eedd30c.en: Click the orange box at the bottom left to update.
Text.04fb8eedd30c.zh-CN: 点击左下角的橙色提示框进行更新。

Text.4e4aff86a1bb.en:
UE MM is at the beginning of its development. This version most likely works. If something does not, an update with a fix follows quickly.

Either way, expect frequent changes: features, screens and texts can still change from one version to the next.
Text.4e4aff86a1bb.zh-CN:
UE MM 尚处于开发初期。此版本应该可以正常使用。如果遇到问题，我们会尽快发布修复更新。

开发期间会频繁更新，功能、界面和文案可能随版本变化。

Text.eee1b0fa369f.en: Backups of your saves and of changed mod settings stay. Mods put straight into the game's Paks folder by hand are not found: for a full check, let Steam or the Epic Games Launcher verify the game files.
Text.eee1b0fa369f.zh-CN: 存档和已修改的模组设置备份将会保留。手动放入游戏 Paks 文件夹的模组无法被检测到。如需完整检查，请使用 Steam 或 Epic 游戏启动器验证游戏文件。

Text.acc364aa126f.en: Also reset the app's settings: the game folder, sorting and other choices. The app then starts again.
Text.acc364aa126f.zh-CN: 同时重置程序设置，包括游戏文件夹、排序和其他选项。程序随后会重新启动。

Text.18b7974b1a46.zh-CN: 没有符合搜索条件的模组

Text.c99aad3f8c6c.en: A mod manager for Unreal Engine games. It installs packaged mods (.pak, .utoc and .ucas), Blueprint mods, and UE4SS Lua and DLL mods, keeps its own copy of every mod, and records a checksum for every file it places. Files it did not place are never overwritten or removed.
Text.c99aad3f8c6c.zh-CN: 适用于虚幻引擎游戏的模组管理器。支持打包模组（.pak、.utoc、.ucas）、蓝图模组和 UE4SS Lua、DLL 模组，为每个模组保留副本，并记录每个部署文件的校验和。管理器不会覆盖或删除非自身部署的文件。

Text.4b2657bf94ac.en: Downloads are unpacked into a private staging folder first. Nothing inside a download is ever run.
Text.4b2657bf94ac.zh-CN: 下载内容会先解压到独立的暂存文件夹中，管理器不会运行其中的任何文件。

Text.73c910aa3287.zh-CN: 在 GitHub 上参与贡献

Text.3a088ede2ad5.en: Made by everyone below. Help improve the original: every contributor is named here, in every release.
Text.3a088ede2ad5.zh-CN: 由以下贡献者共同开发。欢迎帮助改进原项目，每个版本都会在这里列出所有贡献者。

Text.62bf2724117c.en: This app is free software: you may share and change it under the GNU General Public License, version 3, with the additional terms below. A work based on it keeps the credit to the original and its contributors, and carries a name of its own. It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.
Text.62bf2724117c.zh-CN: 本程序是自由软件，您可以依照 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版及以下附加条款分享和修改。衍生作品须保留原项目及贡献者的署名，并使用独立名称。本程序不提供任何担保。

Text.3f92024b2797.en: Archive support by SharpCompress, MVVM helpers by CommunityToolkit.Mvvm. Both use the MIT license, which asks for its text to ship with the app:
Text.3f92024b2797.zh-CN: SharpCompress 提供压缩包支持，CommunityToolkit.Mvvm 提供 MVVM 辅助功能。两者均采用 MIT 许可证，要求随程序附带以下许可文本：

Text.49370e64206a.en: Say in a few words what happened and what you did just before. The manager adds facts about the game, UE4SS and your mods, and leaves out your Windows user name. Nothing is sent: copy the report and paste it into the help channel on Discord.
Text.49370e64206a.zh-CN: 请简要描述问题和发生前的操作。管理器会补充游戏、UE4SS 和模组信息，并隐藏您的 Windows 用户名。报告不会自动发送，请复制后粘贴到 Discord 的帮助频道。

Text.a61af3cb506e.en: In the mods folder, left alone
Text.a61af3cb506e.zh-CN: 模组文件夹中未由管理器部署的文件，不作修改

Text.c59ed2fc878a.en: Drop a .zip, .7z or .rar download, a .pak file or a mod folder anywhere on this window. It is unpacked and checked before anything reaches the game.
Text.c59ed2fc878a.zh-CN: 将下载的 .zip、.7z、.rar 压缩包、.pak 文件或模组文件夹拖放到此窗口即可。安装到游戏前会先解压并检查。

Text.e7e259aef4cf.en: A checksum is recorded for each file the manager places in the game. Disabling a mod removes only its own files, and only while they are unchanged.
Text.e7e259aef4cf.zh-CN: 管理器会记录每个部署到游戏的文件的校验和。禁用模组时，仅删除该模组自身且未经修改的文件。

Text.e59dcddb99fa.en: Reset the settings to the ones the mod came with
Text.e59dcddb99fa.zh-CN: 将设置恢复为模组自带的默认值

Text.8c748652881c.en: Open the manager's copy of this mod
Text.8c748652881c.zh-CN: 打开管理器保存的模组副本

Text.2cc79061d7c5.en: The manager never changes or removes them.
Text.2cc79061d7c5.zh-CN: 管理器不会修改或删除这些文件。

Text.31405bb6198e.en: Found automatically through Steam or the Epic Games Launcher. Choose the folder yourself when it was not found, or to use another copy of the game.
Text.31405bb6198e.zh-CN: 通过 Steam 或 Epic 游戏启动器自动查找。未找到游戏或需要使用其他游戏副本时，请手动选择文件夹。

Text.ccab6b75784a.en: A broken mod can break a save. When you turn it on below, Launch game first zips your save folder, and the manager keeps the last 5 backups. To go back to one, close the game, unzip it and copy its files over the save folder.
Text.ccab6b75784a.zh-CN: 有问题的模组可能损坏存档。开启下方选项后，点击“启动游戏”会先将存档文件夹压缩备份，并保留最近 5 份备份。恢复时，请先关闭游戏，再解压备份，将其中的文件复制到存档文件夹并覆盖。

Text.bbfb91c3aa91.en: Back up my saves each time I start the game here
Text.bbfb91c3aa91.zh-CN: 每次从这里启动游戏时备份存档

Text.0dd4f0daa390.en: Where the manager expects the game's files, as set by the game profile built into this app.
Text.0dd4f0daa390.zh-CN: 由程序内置的游戏配置指定的游戏文件位置。

Text.540de3378af8.en: The list of installed mods, the manager's copy of each mod, backups of your saves and of mod settings you changed, and the logs. All kept in the Data folder next to UEModManager.exe, so the app folder can be moved as a whole.
Text.540de3378af8.zh-CN: 已安装模组列表、各模组副本、存档备份、已修改的模组设置备份及日志均保存在 UEModManager.exe 旁的 Data 文件夹中，您可以整体移动程序文件夹。

Text.3a37ea390c0d.en: Mod settings you changed, saved before an update or an uninstall replaced them
Text.3a37ea390c0d.zh-CN: 更新或卸载模组前，备份您修改过的模组设置

Text.1cd92fdd7bf2.en: Start clean: removes every mod and UE4SS from the game, so it is back to its original files. You choose whether the mods also leave the manager.
Text.1cd92fdd7bf2.zh-CN: 移除游戏中的所有模组和 UE4SS，使游戏恢复原始文件。您可以选择是否同时从管理器中删除模组。

Text.79fe72d78397.en: Something does not work? Make a report for the help channel on Discord: you say what happened, the manager adds the facts a helper asks for first.
Text.79fe72d78397.zh-CN: 遇到问题？为 Discord 帮助频道生成一份报告。您描述发生了什么，管理器补充排查所需的信息。

Text.eac403b63f4e.en: UE4SS loads Lua, DLL and Blueprint mods. Packaged mods (.pak, .utoc, .ucas) work without it.
Text.eac403b63f4e.zh-CN: UE4SS 用于加载 Lua、DLL 和蓝图模组。打包模组（.pak、.utoc、.ucas）无需 UE4SS 即可使用。

Text.202e3614fc39.en: Pick the downloaded zip. The manager unpacks it next to the game's exe and keeps any UE4SS settings you already have.
Text.202e3614fc39.zh-CN: 选择下载好的压缩包。管理器会将其解压到游戏程序旁，并保留现有 UE4SS 设置。

Text.4efc22b570ac.en: Look for UE4SS again after installing it by hand
Text.4efc22b570ac.zh-CN: 手动安装后重新检测 UE4SS

Text.26a6882f13d7.en: UE4SS lets the game load Lua, C++ (DLL) and Blueprint mods. Packaged mods (.pak, .utoc, .ucas) work without it.
Text.26a6882f13d7.zh-CN: UE4SS 让游戏能够加载 Lua、C++（DLL）和蓝图模组。打包模组（.pak、.utoc、.ucas）无需 UE4SS 即可使用。

Text.cce7a491b3a7.en: Install and update keep your UE4SS settings, mods.txt and the files of your mods. Close the game before you change UE4SS.
Text.cce7a491b3a7.zh-CN: 安装和更新时会保留 UE4SS 设置、mods.txt 和模组文件。修改 UE4SS 前请先关闭游戏。

Text.720d8f45b595.en: Copy the log, to paste it into Discord
Text.720d8f45b595.zh-CN: 复制日志，以便粘贴到 Discord

Text.ca3909838dd7.en: What UE4SS wrote during the last game start. Red lines speak of an error, orange lines of a warning.
Text.ca3909838dd7.zh-CN: UE4SS 在上次游戏启动时写入的日志。红色表示错误，橙色表示警告。

Text.ebb4b987190f.zh-CN: 请检查网络连接后重试。

Text.40cb86832988.zh-CN: 因此需要对所在文件夹拥有写入权限。Windows 会保护某些文件夹，例如

Text.0c5d5261909c.zh-CN: C:\Games\UEModManager 或其他磁盘中的文件夹，然后重新启动程序。

Text.5b1835d52ab3.zh-CN: 此构建未包含游戏配置。

Text.8cd6a87f0dd2.zh-CN: 请关闭程序，或在任务管理器中结束 UEModManager.exe，然后重新启动。
